parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78) between `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.defaultsToV1WhenNoOverrideOrFlag` and `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.nonStringFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` is characteristic of test methods that exercise related but distinct behavioural scenarios — default-version fallback vs. non-string feature-flag fallback — within the same test class. Merging or extracting these test methods would obscure the distinct intent of each test case and couple unrelated failure modes. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where all participating records are test fixtures warrants no-action.
